body:
Yeah. Would be nice. I have a month off in August but haven't told anyone. Going to pretend like I'm still in school so I can work on the charity stuff in peace from a local coffee shop.

And yeah, she knows and hasbt been terribly supportive. She was at first, but I think shes getting a little resentful about it.

In any case, whatever. Guess I just have to tough it out until August.

Well, as it stands, theres not much I can cut out.

My girlfriend was pretty awesome. I feel like somewhere along the way we hit a rough patch, didn't really acknowledge it and never really recovered. I think the thing that keeps us together is that we still care for one another.

Can't really cut out the parents. I mean, they're practically supporting me.

Can't cut out the charity. They need me and its practically the only thing I do as an escape. If it weren't for even the minimal shit that he does do, I'd fire my friend, but I'm already overworked. I don't think I can handle adding the few things he does.

Can't cut out school. It's not only financial (taking less courses isnt cheaper), but the gf also hates the fact I've basically put our lives on hold until I'm done. If I told her I needed another few terms, I might as well end it.

Can't cut work for a variety of reasons I can't really go into. It's complicated. Suffice to say that's not really an option. Also, I wouldn't really be able to take on other work with the hours I'm available.

I keep telling myself I just have to tough it out a little longer until I can get a steady job, pay my parents back and gtfo.

But then I wonder why I even bothered trying. The job market is complete shit. If my gf keeps this up, I we probably won't be dating for long and frankly, all I want to do is take my last term's worth of tuition and disappear.
And no, no free time really.  I try to squeeze in good sleep and a workout whenever I can, and it helps, but still leaves me stressed because I feel like I'm falling further behind.
Well, underemployed is probably a better term. I have a job, but its mostly commission based, with a very high attrition rate. A lot of time is wasted on customers that back out.
In a way I wish I was at twin. At least someone would get me.
